content.comment_body: I am attempting to transfer a program to a [article_no] module using [product_name] [version_no] (licensed version from CD). My IP configuration: PC - 192.168.0.99 [product_name] - 192.168.0.1 Both are set to a 255.255.255.0 subnet. The device is directly connected to my laptop. Pressing the "Test" button shows a green check mark, but when I try to transfer the data, nothing happens except a brief box flashing. Upon checking the [product_name], there is no program loaded. Am I missing something essential in the setup? Additionally, I attempted to transfer the program via SD card, but received an error message. I've checked for unusual characters in the network settings and ensured the drivers are current. Previously, I always programmed using a USB cable without any issues.

Is it possible you have the new [product_name] [article_no] FS04? To assist you further, could you specify: - The exact [product_name] module model? - The precise version of [product_name] software you are using?
Thank you for your response. I noticed a similar question just before mine and saw your suggestion to upgrade to [version_no]. I have now done that, and my issue is resolved. Thanks for your help.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered difficulties transferring programs from [product_name] [version_no] software to a [product_name] [article_no] module over LAN. Although the connection test was successful, the actual program did not transfer, and an SD card transfer attempt produced an error. Upgrading the software to [version_no] resolved the issue, highlighting a compatibility problem between software versions that was not clearly indicated in the documentation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect successful program transfers over LAN when the connection test confirms proper setup. They also expect clear guidance or notifications if there are compatibility issues between software and hardware versions.
